title: Sukoon
originalPoem:
Kuch log awaaz se nahi,
apni maujoodgi se sukoon dete hain.
manualNotes: A soft quiet poem about comforting presence.

title: Khamoshi
originalPoem:
Tumhari khamoshi bhi,
aksar baaton se zyada pyari lagti hai.
manualNotes: Affection through silence, not through dramatic words.

title: Yaad
originalPoem:
Kuch yaadein,
dil mein chupke se reh jaati hain,
bina shor kiye.
manualNotes: Gentle memories that stay without noise.

title: Thehrav
originalPoem:
Tum mere din ke us lamhe ki tarah ho,
jahan waqt thoda ruk sa jaata hai.
manualNotes: A moment of pause, softness in the day.

title: Halki Baarish
originalPoem:
Kuch log baarish ki tarah hote hain,
aate hain toh mann bheeg jaata hai,
bina kuch kahe.
manualNotes: People who feel like gentle rain.
